section.title: Bluetooth
section.p: You can easily print on the go from Bluetooth wireless technology-enabled cameras, camera phones, PDAs and other mobile products. Easily print images, messaging, calendar items and more. Built-in support for Bluetooth wireless technology means you can roam and print from up to 10 meters away with a wide range of Bluetooth wireless technology-enabled devices.

Get vibrant photo-quality images plus laser quality black. Printing is both fun and fast. Convenience features such as paper-type sensor, long-lasting ink supplies, print-cancel button, on-screen ink indicator and versatile paper handling help save time and money.
Printing with Bluetooth wireless technology will impact print speeds.

Bluetooth printing requires a mobile phone, tablet, computer or other device equipped with Bluetooth technology v2.0 and optional Bluetooth unit BU-30. Bluetooth operation depends on the devices and software version used. Operating distance is approximately 10 meters but may vary due to obstacles, radio signals, locations where radio interference occurs, magnetic fields from microwave ovens, device sensitivity and/or antenna performance.

section.title: Wi-Fi
section.p: Your printer contains an IEEE 802.11g wireless print server. Your printer is compatible with IEEE 802.11 b, g and n routers that are Wi-Fi certified. If you are having issues with an 802.11n router, verify with your router manufacturer that the current mode setting is compatible with g devices, as this setting varies depending on the router brand/model.
